camel_example: aliyun sas OperateVuls --region cn-hangzhou --Type cve --VulNames.1 'oval:com.ubuntu.xenial:def:2020355240000000' --Uuids.1 '14f14260-xxxx-46ea-a157-451983a10000' --OperateType vul_fix
kebab_example: aliyun sas operate-vuls --type cve --operate-type vul_fix --vul-names oval:com.ubuntu.xenial:def:2020355240000000 --uuids 14f14260-xxxx-46ea-a157-451983a10000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: OperateVuls

parameters.help_en: The type of vulnerability to fix. Set the value to cve, which indicates a Linux software vulnerability
parameters.help_zh: 要修复的漏洞的类型。固定取值：cve，表示Linux软件漏洞
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The method to handle the vulnerability. Set the value to vul_fix, which indicates fixing the vulnerability
parameters.help_zh: 漏洞的处理方式。固定取值：vul_fix，表示修复漏洞
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en: The names of the vulnerabilities to fix
parameters.help_zh: 要修复的漏洞的名称列表
parameters.name: vul_names

parameters.help_en: The UUIDs of the servers on which you want to fix the vulnerabilities
parameters.help_zh: 要修复漏洞的服务器的UUID列表
parameters.name: uuids

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
